input.statement: A close gate reads the register rows behind an artefact, not only its document: the change-control requirement is satisfied by an approved change row, so the factory must open and decide the change before the close. The same pass showed a resolved finding and a published PI plan still blocking a close through their stale P0 cards: a card whose work is done must be receipted and moved, never re-done.
